# Hello!

I am a speech-language pathologist and PhD candidate in Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota. I am studying various aspects of rehabilitation after traumatic brain injury (TBI) under the supervision of [Dr. Natalie Covington](https://cla.umn.edu/about/directory/profile/nvcoving). 

My research examines purpose in life, psychosocial well-being, and adjustment after traumatic brain injury, with particular attention to TBI survivor–care partner dyads.

I am also interested in community-engaged rehabilitation and the scholarship of teaching and learning in communication sciences and disorders.

## {{< fa magnifying-glass >}} Research Interests

- Purpose in life and well-being after traumatic brain injury
- Care partner and dyadic adjustment
- Community-engaged rehabilitation
- Scholarship of teaching and learning
